content.text: In markets like Nigeria and Venezuela, conventional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal are often unavailable, leaving digital creators in a lurch. You need a solution that empowers you to sell digital products like ebooks, courses, and templates without relying on third-party platforms. This guide will show you how to set up a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-what-nobody-tells-19|COREMERCH guide to sovereign]] digital commerce stack that leverages crypto payments and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-every-detail-you-2|Automated Digital]]-ebook-delivery-after-crypto-payment-every-detail-6|automated]] delivery. You can take control of your e-commerce without platform constraints and retain your profits.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-every-detail-you-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Platforms like Gumroad charge excessive fees of up to 10% on sales, which can significantly cut into your profits. With NOWPayments, you only incur a 0.5% fee. By choosing this infrastructure, you retain more of your revenue. For example, if you sell a product for $97 and make 100 sales a month, opting for NOWPayments over Gumroad retains you $921 annually. This infrastructure not only provides cost-effectiveness but also ensures that you own all aspects of your store, including your data and product delivery.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can go live, gather all necessary assets. You will need your digital products ready for upload, such as ebooks, courses, or templates. Set up a free GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting your store. Ensure you have a NOWPayments account ready for crypto transactions. Finally, decide which delivery method works for you: Cloudflare Workers for automated delivery or Google Apps Script for backend logic. Having these elements prepared will streamline the deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To initiate your payment and delivery pipeline, start by integrating NOWPayments with your store. This will allow you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, facilitating seamless transactions. Next, configure your delivery method. If you use Cloudflare Workers, write a script that verifies payment and delivers digital products automatically. Alternatively, with Google Apps Script, set up a function that triggers once payment confirmation is received. Your pipeline will be ready to handle sales efficiently.
Retain more profits with a 0.5% payment processing fee.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once everything is set up, it’s time to go live. Publish your store on GitHub or Cloudflare Pages. Promote your store through social media and digital marketing channels. When a customer makes a purchase, the NOWPayments integration will handle the cryptocurrency transaction and confirm payment. Ensure you monitor the transaction flow to quickly resolve any issues. Processing your first transaction marks the beginning of your independent e-commerce journey.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your store is operational, focus on scaling. Start by analyzing sales data to identify top-performing products. You can add more products or diversify your offerings based on customer preferences. Utilize the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to access advanced blueprints and templates that can help you optimize your store. Consider integrating more crypto payment options to attract a wider audience. With a solid infrastructure, scaling becomes a straightforward process.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Automated delivery systems eliminate manual work.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I start selling ebooks without using PayPal or Stripe?

You can start selling ebooks by setting up a digital store using GitHub Pages and integrating NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This setup allows you to process payments without relying on traditional payment platforms.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?

The best way is to create your own store using tools like GitHub Pages and integrate NOWPayments for low transaction fees. This approach gives you complete ownership and control over your sales and profits.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by deploying your own digital store with a sovereign commerce stack. Integrating NOWPayments allows you to accept crypto payments and automate product delivery.
What are the costs involved in setting up my store?

Setting up your store can be done at minimal cost. Hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare is free, and using NOWPayments incurs only a 0.5% fee on transactions, significantly lower than platforms like Gumroad.
How do I ensure my customers receive their products after purchase?

You can automate product delivery using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Upon payment confirmation through NOWPayments, the delivery system will send the digital product to the customer automatically.
You own everything—data and products—after deployment.
